sara_p: Quick checkwe need one-liner profiles for GA copy. Which two profiles do we guarantee at launch?
aj_eng: Suggest 'Quickstart (single-node VPC)' and 'VPC-isolated (multi-subnet)'. Keep air-gapped as enterprise-only.
lina_se: +1. Also call out support level: Quickstart = self-serve, VPC-isolated = SE-assisted.
chloe_ops: For GA we must have: installer preflight, port list, KMS support, and opt-in aggregated telemetry. Air-gap gets limited telemetry (local files).
mike_product: Landing GA gates: installer idempotency, diag CLI, telemetry schema, rollback window. Propose rollback = 15m for GA.
aj_eng: I'll prototype diag CLI that prints DNS/port/cert checks and a small telemetry YAML.
chloe_ops: Ops will draft runbook checklist for both profiles. SEs get a one-pager for field installs.
sara_p: Good. Action items: @aj_eng diag + telemetry sample, @lina_se SE one-pager, @chloe_ops runbooks, I'll consolidate language for marketing. Reconvene Wed after PRD draft.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch private/profiles -> staging at 2026-04-10T14:00:00Z :rocket:
